itinerary.title:
Day 1 - Graceful Hanoi Arrival
& Welcome Dinner
description: Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, you are welcomed by a dedicated concierge representative and escorted by luxury private transfer to Peridot Grand Luxury Boutique Hotel. The day remains intentionally light, allowing you and your group time to settle in and refresh. In the evening, a curated welcome dinner introduces Northern Vietnamese cuisine in a refined setting, setting a graceful tone for the journey ahead.
meals: Dinner; Lunch subjects to arrival time

itinerary.title: Day 2 — Hanoi
description: This half-day introduction to Hanoi focuses on the capital’s essential cultural landmarks at an unhurried pace. With a private historian guide, you visit the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum Complex, One Pillar Pagoda, and the elegant Temple of Literature, Vietnam’s first national university. The experience offers a thoughtful perspective on national memory, Confucian heritage, and the ceremonial rhythm of old Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Day 3 — Hanoi
description:
Depart Hanoi for the spectacular landscapes of Ninh
                Binh. The program features a private sampan excursion through the tranquil waterways and majestic
                limestone karsts of Trang An. This meticulously arranged day trip offers a profound connection with
                Vietnam's natural beauty with the utmost privacy.

itinerary.title: Day 4 — Halong Bay
description:
A private transfer conveys guests to the coastal city
                of Ha Long to board the distinguished Celina Of The Sea Cruise. After checking into the Executive
                Balcony suite, the afternoon is spent cruising through the UNESCO World Heritage seascape.

itinerary.title: Day 5 — Hoi An
description:
Following a leisurely morning on the cruise, guests
                disembark and are transferred for a short domestic flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, a private chauffeur
                provides a seamless transfer to the Anantara Hoi An Resort. The afternoon includes a premium bespoke
                tailoring consultation, a hallmark experience of this historic trading port.

itinerary.title: Day 6 — Hoi An
description:
A full-day guided exploration of the beautifully
                preserved Hoi An Ancient Town. The private tour delves into the architectural marvels and rich trading
                history of the area. The evening concludes with a refined dining experience, showcasing the intricate
                flavors of Central Vietnamese cuisine.

itinerary.title: Day 7 — Hoi An
description:
The morning features a specialized photography tour,
                designed to capture professional portraits of the family against the iconic, lantern backdrop of Hoi An.
                The afternoon is reserved for leisure, allowing guests to fully enjoy the premium amenities and tranquil
                environment of the Anantara Resort.

itinerary.title: Day 8 — Da Nang
description: The journey continues with a transfer to the coastal city of Da Nang, while some of the members say goodbye to Vietnam, the other continue their journey. Enjoy the afternoon at your own leisure to experience the city at your personal pace. Whether you prefer quiet moments of tranquility or spontaneous exploration, this time is entirely yours to shape as you wish.

itinerary.title: Day 9 — Da Nang
description:
A premium excursion to the elevated resort of Ba Na Hills. The itinerary includes priority access to the cable car
              system and a guided walk across the architectural masterpiece, the Golden Bridge. Guests will explore the French Village
              before returning to the sanctuary of their beachfront villa.

itinerary.title: Day 10 — Hue
description:
A full-day excursion to the former imperial capital of
                Hue. The privately guided itinerary encompasses the majestic Imperial Citadel and the opulent royal
                mausoleums, offering an in-depth perspective on Vietnam's regal history and architectural grandeur under
                the Nguyen Dynasty.

itinerary.title: Day 11 — Da Nang
description:
A day allocated entirely for leisure at the beachfront
                villa, allowing guests to relax by their private pool or partake in the resort's luxury wellness
                offerings. The evening is highlighted by a second, meticulously planned surprise, an exclusive dining
                experience orchestrated by the resort’s culinary team.

itinerary.title: Day 12 — Ho Chi Minh City
description:
Following a seamless domestic flight to Ho Chi Minh
                City, guests embark on a privately guided tour of the historic Cu Chi Tunnels, gaining insight into this
                remarkable underground network, meeting exclusively with a war veteran. The day concludes with check-in
                at The Reverie Saigon, an establishment renowned for its opulent Italian design and world-class service.

itinerary.title: Day 13 — Mekong Delta
description:
An immersive full-day journey into the Mekong Delta.
                Traveling aboard a private river vessel, guests observe the vibrant riverine culture and visit local
                artisanal workshops. This carefully curated excursion provides a sophisticated and comfortable approach
                to exploring one of Vietnam's most vital agricultural regions.

itinerary.title: Day 14 — Departure
description:
The final morning is at the guests' leisure to enjoy
                the premium facilities of The Reverie Saigon. At the appropriate time, a private chauffeur will provide
                a seamless transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for the departing flight, concluding a
                flawlessly executed luxury journey.

letter_intro:
I am delighted to present this privately arranged journey: Tina’s Vietnam
                    Birthday Escape, created for 11 passengers
                 travelling from 27 Mar – 09 Apr 2027. The route unfolds from Hanoi – Halong Bay – Hoi An – Da Nang – Hue – Ho Chi Minh City.
letter_body_p2:
The programme has been considered around a gentler friendly rhythm: early
                check-in in Hanoi, private guiding and transfers, a luxury overnight cruise, and enough space
                between active days to pause. Dining, room arrangements and transitions have been planned with care,
                without adding unnecessary movement.
letter_outro:
Please review the journey as a starting point for a personal conversation.
                Every final detail can be refined around your preferred pace, room choices, and priorities.

itinerary.summary: Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, guests are warmly received by our dedicated concierge team and escorted via luxury private transfer to the Peridot Grand Luxury Boutique Hotel. The evening features a curated welcome dinner, offering a sophisticated introduction to Northern Vietnamese culinary traditions in a refined setting.

The day is devoted to a comprehensive exploration of Hanoi’s rich heritage. Accompanied by a private historian guide, the itinerary includes exclusive visits to the city's most significant cultural landmarks. The pace is deliberately unhurried, ensuring an immersive and private experience away from standard tourist routes.

Guests depart Hanoi for the spectacular landscapes of Ninh Binh. The program features a private sampan excursion through the tranquil waterways and majestic limestone karsts of Trang An. This meticulously arranged day trip offers a profound connection with Vietnam's natural beauty with the utmost privacy.

A private transfer conveys guests to the coastal city of Ha Long to board the distinguished Celina Of The Sea Cruise. After checking into the Executive Balcony suite, the afternoon is spent cruising through the UNESCO World Heritage seascape. As evening approaches, the crew will execute a seamlessly orchestrated birthday celebration, complete with a bespoke private dinner arrangement.

Following a leisurely morning on the cruise, guests disembark and are transferred for a short domestic flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, a private chauffeur provides a seamless transfer to the Anantara Hoi An Resort. The afternoon includes a premium bespoke tailoring consultation, a hallmark experience of this historic trading port.

A full-day guided exploration of the beautifully preserved Hoi An Ancient Town. The private tour delves into the architectural marvels and rich trading history of the area. The evening concludes with a refined dining experience, showcasing the intricate flavors of Central Vietnamese cuisine.

The morning features a specialized photography tour, designed to capture professional portraits of the family against the iconic, lantern-lit backdrop of Hoi An. The afternoon is reserved for leisure, allowing guests to fully enjoy the premium amenities and tranquil environment of the Anantara Resort.

The journey continues with a transfer to the coastal city of Da Nang, coupled with a curated half-day city tour highlighting local cultural landmarks. Guests will then check into a spectacular 3-Bedroom Beach Front Pool Villa at the Hyatt Regency Danang Resort and Spa, providing an unparalleled standard of privacy and comfort.

A premium excursion to the elevated resort of Ba Na Hills. The itinerary includes priority access to the cable car system and a guided walk across the architectural masterpiece, the Golden Bridge. Guests will explore the French Village before returning to the sanctuary of their beachfront villa.

A day allocated entirely for leisure at the beachfront villa, allowing guests to relax by their private pool or partake in the resort's luxury wellness offerings. The evening is highlighted by a second, meticulously planned birthday celebration—an exclusive dining experience orchestrated by the resort’s culinary team within the privacy of the villa.

Following a seamless domestic flight to Ho Chi Minh City, guests embark on a privately guided tour of the historic Cu Chi Tunnels, gaining insight into this remarkable underground network. The day concludes with check-in at The Reverie Saigon, an establishment renowned for its opulent Italian design and world-class service.

An immersive full-day journey into the Mekong Delta. Traveling aboard a private luxury river vessel, guests observe the vibrant riverine culture and visit local artisanal workshops. This carefully curated excursion provides a sophisticated and comfortable approach to exploring one of Vietnam's most vital agricultural regions.

The final morning is at the guests' leisure to enjoy the premium facilities of The Reverie Saigon. At the appropriate time, a private chauffeur will provide a seamless transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for the departing flight, concluding a flawlessly executed luxury journey.

edited_fields.itinerary_p: Your private 14D13N journey — 14 days, carefully crafted.
edited_fields.day_title_1:
Day 1 - Graceful Hanoi Arrival
& Welcome Dinner
edited_fields.day_desc_1_0: Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, you are welcomed by a dedicated concierge representative and escorted by luxury private transfer to Peridot Grand Luxury Boutique Hotel. The day remains intentionally light, allowing you and your group time to settle in and refresh. In the evening, a curated welcome dinner introduces Northern Vietnamese cuisine in a refined setting, setting a graceful tone for the journey ahead.
edited_fields.day_meals_1: Dinner; Lunch subjects to arrival time
edited_fields.day_desc_2_0: This half-day introduction to Hanoi focuses on the capital’s essential cultural landmarks at an unhurried pace. With a private historian guide, you visit the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum Complex, One Pillar Pagoda, and the elegant Temple of Literature, Vietnam’s first national university. The experience offers a thoughtful perspective on national memory, Confucian heritage, and the ceremonial rhythm of old Hanoi.
edited_fields.day_highlights_2: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum Complex, One Pillar Pagoda, Temple of Literature
edited_fields.day_desc_3_0:
Depart Hanoi for the spectacular landscapes of Ninh
                Binh. The program features a private sampan excursion through the tranquil waterways and majestic
                limestone karsts of Trang An. This meticulously arranged day trip offers a profound connection with
                Vietnam's natural beauty with the utmost privacy.
edited_fields.day_desc_4_0:
A private transfer conveys guests to the coastal city
                of Ha Long to board the distinguished Celina Of The Sea Cruise. After checking into the Executive
                Balcony suite, the afternoon is spent cruising through the UNESCO World Heritage seascape.
edited_fields.day_desc_5_0:
Following a leisurely morning on the cruise, guests
                disembark and are transferred for a short domestic flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, a private chauffeur
                provides a seamless transfer to the Anantara Hoi An Resort. The afternoon includes a premium bespoke
                tailoring consultation, a hallmark experience of this historic trading port.
edited_fields.day_desc_6_0:
A full-day guided exploration of the beautifully
                preserved Hoi An Ancient Town. The private tour delves into the architectural marvels and rich trading
                history of the area. The evening concludes with a refined dining experience, showcasing the intricate
                flavors of Central Vietnamese cuisine.
edited_fields.day_desc_7_0:
The morning features a specialized photography tour,
                designed to capture professional portraits of the family against the iconic, lantern backdrop of Hoi An.
                The afternoon is reserved for leisure, allowing guests to fully enjoy the premium amenities and tranquil
                environment of the Anantara Resort.
edited_fields.day_desc_8_0: The journey continues with a transfer to the coastal city of Da Nang, while some of the members say goodbye to Vietnam, the other continue their journey. Enjoy the afternoon at your own leisure to experience the city at your personal pace. Whether you prefer quiet moments of tranquility or spontaneous exploration, this time is entirely yours to shape as you wish.
edited_fields.day_desc_9_0:
A premium excursion to the elevated resort of Ba Na Hills. The itinerary includes priority access to the cable car
              system and a guided walk across the architectural masterpiece, the Golden Bridge. Guests will explore the French Village
              before returning to the sanctuary of their beachfront villa.
edited_fields.day_highlights_9: Private transfer · Ba Na Hills ticket.
edited_fields.day_desc_10_0:
A full-day excursion to the former imperial capital of
                Hue. The privately guided itinerary encompasses the majestic Imperial Citadel and the opulent royal
                mausoleums, offering an in-depth perspective on Vietnam's regal history and architectural grandeur under
                the Nguyen Dynasty.
edited_fields.day_highlights_10: Imperial Citadel · architecture of the Nguyen Dynasty.
edited_fields.day_desc_11_0:
A day allocated entirely for leisure at the beachfront
                villa, allowing guests to relax by their private pool or partake in the resort's luxury wellness
                offerings. The evening is highlighted by a second, meticulously planned surprise, an exclusive dining
                experience orchestrated by the resort’s culinary team.
edited_fields.day_desc_12_0:
Following a seamless domestic flight to Ho Chi Minh
                City, guests embark on a privately guided tour of the historic Cu Chi Tunnels, gaining insight into this
                remarkable underground network, meeting exclusively with a war veteran. The day concludes with check-in
                at The Reverie Saigon, an establishment renowned for its opulent Italian design and world-class service.
edited_fields.day_desc_13_0:
An immersive full-day journey into the Mekong Delta.
                Traveling aboard a private river vessel, guests observe the vibrant riverine culture and visit local
                artisanal workshops. This carefully curated excursion provides a sophisticated and comfortable approach
                to exploring one of Vietnam's most vital agricultural regions.
edited_fields.day_desc_14_0:
The final morning is at the guests' leisure to enjoy
                the premium facilities of The Reverie Saigon. At the appropriate time, a private chauffeur will provide
                a seamless transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for the departing flight, concluding a
                flawlessly executed luxury journey.

top_level.letter_intro:
I am delighted to present this privately arranged journey: Tina’s Vietnam
                    Birthday Escape, created for 11 passengers
                 travelling from 27 Mar – 09 Apr 2027. The route unfolds from Hanoi – Halong Bay – Hoi An – Da Nang – Hue – Ho Chi Minh City.
top_level.letter_body_p2:
The programme has been considered around a gentler friendly rhythm: early
                check-in in Hanoi, private guiding and transfers, a luxury overnight cruise, and enough space
                between active days to pause. Dining, room arrangements and transitions have been planned with care,
                without adding unnecessary movement.
top_level.letter_outro:
Please review the journey as a starting point for a personal conversation.
                Every final detail can be refined around your preferred pace, room choices, and priorities.
